## Limits of this evidence

- Inputs are tiny synthetic texts. Each probe sends one request; at most two retries in total.
- The Wonder role call is a synthetic repair exercise. It is not evidence of PostgreSQL or gate-driven repair.
- UNKNOWN means inconclusive or not run; it does not mean unsupported.
- Cost bounds assume at least one byte of request body per input unit, plus a fixed allowance of 512 for message framing.
- Usage-based estimates assume reported output units include any reasoning units. Billing can lag.
- Raw responses and hidden reasoning text are not stored; only visible replies, tool-call arguments and numeric usage.
- Model-supplied tool calls were validated, never executed.
